final: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major) SELECT major_id, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM major_counts) AS share_of_total, member_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(member_count) FROM major_counts) AS count_to_average_ratio FROM major_counts ORDER BY count_to_average_ratio DESC, major_id LIMIT 10
